_how_it_is_used: server_scripts/grindless/uxv/cygnus_lift.js makes one recipe per entry, id grindless:<type>/<name>, with its programmed circuit; 'site' true locks the recipe to grindless:cygnus_x1_orbit. star_lifting, plasma_mass_filtering and stellar_condensation are package UXV-B2's machine types (data key = dataKey, the EMI line). Package UXV-B2, docs/eras/uxv.md machines 10-12 and process line 26.

recipes._why: machine 10 c1: liquid helium cools the lift tube while a magnetic funnel draws stellar plasma off the Cygnus X-1 donor; 900 mB of warm helium returns to UV's cold works
recipes.name: stellar_lift

recipes._why: machine 10 c2: a data module records the plasma column's flow; 100 mB of the plasma it samples is consumed
recipes.name: elevator_log

recipes._why: machine 11 c1: the solenoid sorts the stellar plasma by mass into four cuts
recipes.name: stellar_cuts

recipes._why: machine 11 c2: the same sorting on the accretion disk's plasma (B3's disk_plasma); the heavy tenth comes out as the heavy cut
recipes.name: disk_filter

recipes._why: MAX-D1 (max.md, L16 step 2, c3): at Sgr A* the solenoid sorts the hot flow; 1,350 mB go on to the FRC former, the heavy tenth comes out as the heavy cut
recipes.name: hot_flow_filter

recipes._why: MAX-D1 (max.md, L16 step 4 return, c4): the BZ dynamo's cooled exhaust is sorted again; it is consumed here, never returned to the line, and comes out as hydrogen and the heavy cut
recipes.name: cooled_exhaust_return

recipes._why: machine 12 c1: the heavy cut condenses by stage into refractory, metal and silicate condensate; the hydrogen cut carries the volatiles off the top (to syngas)
recipes.name: condense
